children: Two Southern California refineries reported unplanned flaring events on Saturday, according to regulatory filings with South Coast Air Quality Management District.
The Wilmington section of Marathon's 384,500 b/d Los Angeles refinery reported unplanned flaring Saturday evening, with "initial determination unknown" listed as the cause for the event.
A company spokesperson did not immediately respond to request for comment.

Valero's 93,500 b/d Wilmington refinery reported "unplanned maintenance" as the cause for weekend flaring, according to a filing with SCAQMD. Valero's Wilmington facility reported a similar unplanned flare event on Friday.
A Valero spokesperson did not immediately respond to request for comment.

PADD 5 (U.S. West Coast) refineries have averaged a 91% utilization rate since the first week of June, according to data compiled by the U.S. Energy Information Administration. Even so, regional gasoline inventories are sitting at their lowest levels since early June.

U.S. West Coast gasoline stockpiles have not surpassed 30 million bbl since mid-February. This is also around the timeframe Valero began to wind down operations at its 150,000 b/d Benicia refinery in Northern California, OPIS previously reported.

Gasoline imports into the PADD 5 region totaled 106,000 b/d the week ended Aug. 21, according to EIA data, but the four-week average sits at 48,000 b/d. This time last year, the four-week average was closer to 85,000 b/d.

California refiner stocks of CARB reformulated gasoline totaled 4.165 million bbl the week ended Aug. 21, according to data compiled by the California Energy Commission. Year-ago levels were closer to 6 million bbl, and this time two years ago RFG inventories amounted to 5.507 million bbl, CEC data showed.

Regional U.S. West Coast distillates inventories were reported at 10.6 million bbl the week ended Aug. 21, according to EIA data. Statewide refiner stocks of California-compliant diesel totaled 1.208 million bbl, versus last year's 1.563 million bbl.
The West Coast region is historically long diesel, but trading participants have reported allocation limits and even outages at some California-area terminals in recent weeks.
